camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyAccountDescription --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription testuser --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --AccountName test1
description_en: Modifies the description of a database account
description_zh: 该接口用于修改数据库账号的描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-account-description --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --account-name test1 --account-description testuser --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAccountDescription

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the account. You can call the DescribeAccounts operation to obtain the username of the account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the account. The value must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The value can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter.

The description cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
账号描述，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头
parameters.name: account_description
